plan_details.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate mastery of the basics of singing and acting
plan_details.main_activity: (a) Act with or without vocalization
plan_details.teaching_learning_resources: Masks, ngoma, costumes, makeups and various props used in acting
plan_details.references: TIE(2024) Sports Arts and Culture for Primary Schools. Pupils Book Class Five. Dar es salaam.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains what acting is; differentiates between vocal and non-vocal acting; demonstrates simple examples.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Listen, observe, and share experiences of acting in school plays.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Attributes of living and non- living things with or without vocalization are accurately acted

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Demonstrates facial expressions showing happiness, sadness, fear, and anger.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Gives feedback and helps students improve their expressions.
